title: GyxerChat
description: Chat enchancing plugin to work on top of your chat formatting plugins, adding functionalities such as sharing items and inventories to chat, and creation of custom chat placeholders!
body:
### >  **ABOUT**
- The chat is great, players can socialize with each other. But here's the thing, why not make it even more interact-able? With this plugin, you will be able to show your item in hand, inventory content and ender chest content with your friends! Even across servers in your global Paper chat!

This plugin also allows you to create your own interactive keywords for your players to use in chat!

GyxerChat is designed to work on top of your existing chat formatting plugin, not as a replacement!

###  Using DiscordSRV?
- GyxerChat has an inbuilt DiscordSRV , to connect Your discord server chat and minecraft chat
